name: stasis_snare_returns_the_creature_when_it_leaves
notes: P50a878933a G4. Printed: '... exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.' (CR 610.3c: the exiled card returns to the battlefield under its owner's control when the Snare leaves.) Seat 0 casts Stasis Snare and exiles seat 1's Wolf. Another effect then destroys the Snare (moved to its owner's graveyard): the Wolf returns to the battlefield under seat 1's control.
